order_wins: **Power Grid Corporation of India** — declared **successful bidder under Tariff Based Competitive Bidding** for the Barmer-II 6 GW HVDC terminals and the ~1,000 km bipole to South Kalamb, at **quoted annual transmission charges of Rs 3,244.33 crore** on a BOOT basis; letter of intent received today.

**GPT Infraprojects** — declared **L-1 (First Lowest), not awarded**, on a **Rs 483.70 crore tender including GST from Rail Vikas Nigam** _(~34.1% of mcap)_ for an open-web steel girder bridge over the Mahanadi on the Nergundi-Barang line; the letter of award is still to come.

**BEML** — an **additional order of about Rs 180.60 crore from Integral Coach Factory** for manufacture and supply of Vande Bharat (Sleeper) trainsets _(~1.1% of mcap)_, which the filing states is in the normal course of business.

**Indo Tech Transformers** — purchase orders of **Rs 165.55 crore plus taxes from AP TRANSCO** for 17 transformers of 80 MVA 220/33 kV and 9 of 80 MVA 132/33 kV _(~4.3% of mcap)_, all delivered between October 2026 and June 2027.

**Konstelec Engineers** — an amendment RAISES its Reliance Industries work order for Jamnagar electrical and instrumentation work **from Rs 4.12 crore to Rs 9.19 crore, an increase of Rs 5.06 crore**, for completion by 30 November 2026.

**KD Green Industries** — 51% subsidiary **Shivam Pipe Industries** secures a **Rs 7.79 crore order from Star Infratech** for GI steel tubular poles under the RDSS scheme, awarded through a contractor to Meghalaya Power Distribution, for delivery in September.

**Veerhealth Care** — receives an order for skincare products from **one of India's largest FMCG companies at an accepted value of Rs 436.99 lakh, about Rs 4.37 crore**; the filing names neither the customer nor a delivery schedule.

**Kabra Extrusiontechnik** — its GEON brand receives a **Letter of Intent from one of India's top three two-wheeler manufacturers** to develop and supply two battery-pack programmes. The filer names neither the customer nor any value.

**Iware Supplychain Services** — signs a one-year **Transportation Agreement with Tube Investments of India** effective 1 September, priced on freight rates, which the annexure states carries **no fixed minimum volume or guaranteed business**.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Wheels India** — a corrigendum lifts its preferential issue price **from Rs 1,418 to Rs 1,461 a share** after NSE observations forced a revised valuation, amending the allottee share counts while **total consideration stays at Rs 180 crore**; EGM 17 September.

**Natural Capsules** — its board revises a promoter preferential issue to **1,12,500 equity shares plus 4,50,000 warrants at Rs 178, Rs 2.00 crore and Rs 8.01 crore**, to Sunil L Mundra, taking him to 10.61% on full conversion; EGM 9 September.

**Resourceful Automobile** — its board approves **up to 3,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 51, Rs 1,53,00,000**, to promoter Rahul Sawhney, who moves from 45.63% to 51.15% on conversion; subject to a special resolution at an EGM.

**Step Two Corporation** — its board approves a **preferential issue of 23,50,000 equity shares at Rs 17, Rs 3,99,50,000**, to non-promoters, and raises authorised capital from Rs 7.85 crore to Rs 12.00 crore; the resolution goes to the 28 September AGM.

**Sunrest Lifescience** — its board **extends the closing of its open rights issue by nine days to 11 September**, from 2 September, to give shareholders longer to exercise; the issue opened on 18 August.

**Kirloskar Electric** — after NSE observations on its in-principle approval application, the board **consolidates the objects of its proposed preferential issue of equity shares into a single stated object**; the issue itself is unchanged.

**Quality Power Electrical Equipments** — its board **DEFERS the proposed preferential issue** to shareholders of Winwin Speciality Insulators pending due diligence and a choice of fund-raising mode, stating that preferential-issue disclosures are "not presently attracted" as no decision was taken.

**Genesys International** — its board approves a new **Genesys ESOP Scheme 2026** and the appointment of G. K. Choksi & Co as statutory auditors for five years from the 44th AGM, replacing MSKA & Associates; both go to the members.
equity_allotments: **Trishakti Industries** — allots **4,18,000 equity shares at Rs 158.10, Rs 4,95,64,350**, on exercise of warrants issued on **8 October 2025**: a past conversion completing, the balance 75% now received from four holders.

**Shree Karni Fabcom** — allots **1,05,000 equity shares at Rs 765, Rs 8,03,25,000**, on conversion of warrants issued in January 2025 to four promoters, on receipt of the balance 75% of Rs 6,02,43,750: a past conversion, not new capital.

**Shukra Pharmaceuticals** — allots **11,73,000 equity shares of Re 1 at Rs 35.56 to promoter Navkar Surgical Gujarat** on conversion of warrants issued 28 January 2026, on the balance Rs 3,12,83,910; **17,35,000 warrants remain outstanding**.

**RLF** — allots **13,00,000 equity shares at Rs 10.50, Rs 1,36,50,000**, to promoter group members Ashish and Aditya Khanna **in conversion of outstanding unsecured loans**, taking the promoter group from 34.68% to 42.44%. No cash came in.

**Minolta Finance** — files the **Final Post Issue Report** for its completed rights issue of 40,00,00,000 shares of Re 1 at Rs 1.20, **Rs 48,00,00,000**, the enclosed BSE letter confirming those shares listed with effect from 1 September.

**BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle** — allots **29,305 equity shares of Re 1 to employees** on exercise of vested options under its 2014 plan, and appoints Mandar Godbole company secretary with immediate effect.
m_and_a: **ICICI Bank** — **completes the purchase of 2,90,15,693 equity shares, about 2.00%, of ICICI Prudential Life for approximately Rs 14.70 billion** in tranches between 22 July and 2 September through the exchange mechanism, lifting its holding to ~52.8%.

**RPG Life Sciences** — wholly owned RPG Active Pharma signs a Business Transfer Agreement to **buy Raghava Life Sciences' API and intermediates business by slump sale for up to Rs 135.00 crore in cash** _(~3.0% of mcap)_, with 29 molecules, manufacturing and R&D sites.

**Gayatri Highways** — **completes the sale of its 49% stake in HKR Roadways to Cube Highways and Infrastructure V PTE for Rs 57.32 crore received** _(~124.6% of mcap)_, a filing 68 minutes earlier having estimated about Rs 200 crore plus Rs 48 crore contingent on the Wholesale Price Index.

**Tilaknagar Industries** — subscribes **Rs 22.00 crore for 30% of Black Tiger Distilleries** on a fully diluted basis, Rs 6 crore in the first tranche and Rs 16 crore within twelve months, entering the tequila and agave category.

**Fine Organic Industries** — **executes Share Transfer Agreements to acquire 80% of Oleofine Organics SDN BHD, Malaysia**, a specialty chemicals maker with a turnover of RM 23,287,742 for the year to January 2026; no rupee consideration is stated.

**AJC Jewel Manufacturers** — buys **80% of AJC Jewel Manufacturers (FZC), Sharjah from promoter-group seller Afzal Rahman Perinkadakkad for at most Rs 9,59,96,946** _(~11.2% of mcap)_, discharged wholly in 5,67,492 preferential shares at Rs 169.16.

**Blue Star** — wholly owned Blue Star Engineering & Electronics **completes the slump sale of its MedTech business to Cyrix Healthcare effective 1 September**; the consideration is payable in tranches to 31 March 2027 and is not disclosed.

**MSP Steel & Power** — its board approves the **draft Scheme of Arrangement demerging a business of MSP Sponge Iron into the company** under sections 230-232, on the audit committee's recommendation and subject to regulatory approvals.

**Mish Designs** — subsidiary I'Design Fashions **executes a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the "DeMoza" brand from Pipin Fashions**, with eight existing DeMoza stores; no consideration appears anywhere in the filing.

**Bharat Forge** — Kalyani Powertrain **completes the divestment of its entire 50% stake in REFU Drive GmbH to REFU Elektronik GmbH**, so REFU ceases to be a joint venture; the July intimation stands amended and no value is restated.

**Shera Energy** — its board approves an investment in **Shera Global Ventures LLP**, a related entity; the covering letter states no amount, which sits in the annexure the cached text does not reach.

**Thomas Cook (India)** — receives **NSE's observation letter** on its composite scheme of arrangement with Sterling Holiday Resorts, TC Visa Services, Jardin Travel Solutions and Borderless Travel Services; a procedural step, not an approval.

**HEG** — renamed **HEG Advanced Materials Limited with effect from 2 September**, on a fresh certificate of incorporation, its composite scheme of arrangement sanctioned by NCLT Indore having become effective on 1 September.
**Aarti Pharmalabs** — receives an order from the Superintendent of Stamps, Gandhinagar **adjudicating stamp duty on the 2022 demerger** from Aarti Industries under the Gujarat Stamp Act.

**Simplex Papers** — sells the land of its **closed paper plant at Korani, Gondia** by sale deed executed today for **Rs 25,00,000** to two unrelated individuals; the land contributed no revenue last year and members approved the sale on 4 August.

**K2 Infragen** — buys the remaining **30.53% of subsidiary K2 Nextgen Solutions for Rs 22,89,750**, 1,52,650 shares at Rs 15, taking it to 100%; the filing states this is a related party transaction done at arm's length.

**India Cements** — invests **up to Rs 14,06,27,240 for 26% of Amplus TN One Energy**, an SPV for 41.80 MW (AC) of solar with battery storage supplying four cement units in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana on a **captive** basis; closing within 180 days.
capex_core: **Goldiam International** — redirects the **Rs 152.80 crore of QIP proceeds still unutilised**: Rs 107.80 crore to the 35 brand-exclusive stores still to open, cutting the programme from 63 to 60, and Rs 45.00 crore to general corporate purposes, the deadline moving to December 2027.

**Bondada Engineering** — incorporates wholly owned **Bondada Hindupur BESS Project** as the SPV to build, own and operate a **225 MW / 450 MWh battery energy storage system awarded by AP Transco** on a build-own-operate model, all approvals already obtained.

**Krishival Foods** — drops its planned purchase of more Melt 'N' Mellow Foods equity and instead lends the subsidiary **Rs 25 crore of rights-issue proceeds for 10,000 deep freezers**, plus Rs 10 crore more and a Rs 35 crore guarantee, both subject to members.

**Afcom Holdings** — executes a **letter of intent with The Boeing Company to BUY up to four Boeing 777-8F freighter aircraft**, subject to finalisation of definitive documents. No consideration is stated anywhere in the filing.

**Amanta Healthcare** — **commissions a new SteriPort line at its Kheda campus**, a brownfield addition of sterile two-port IV containers with higher automation; the filing states no project cost and no capacity figure.

**TCM** — launches **poultry feed on leased premises at Kanjikode, Palakkad, adding about 1,500 tonnes a month** against 1,000 tonnes of existing cattle-feed capacity, for **Rs 2.50 crore** of machinery and working capital from internal accruals.
**Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure** — infuses a **fourth tranche of SAR 1,02,000, about Rs 26.12 lakh**, for 15 shares of wholly owned Tinna Rubber Arabia, Saudi Arabia, at SAR 6,800 a share.

**Ashika Global Securities** — SEBI **extends by six months the validity of its in-principle approval to sponsor and set up a mutual fund**, from 29 June; final registration remains conditional on meeting the letter's requirements.

**Rajputana Industries** — its board outcome of 2 September is in the store at Rs 8.20 crore, but the cached text of the filing stops at the covering address block, so **what the board approved is not in what we read** and no claim is made about it.
business_updates: **Results season** — 9 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Housing & Urban Development Corporation** — signs an MoU with the **Government of Bihar to provide financial assistance of up to Rs 25,000 crore over five years** for industrial infrastructure including land acquisition; the MoU records intent, with operational agreements to follow.

**Anlon Technology Solutions** — files a Business Standard advertorial on its airport firefighting and runway-maintenance business, in which **manufacturing and assembly revenue rose to Rs 53.41 crore in FY26 from Rs 6.46 crore**. A newspaper publication, not a Reg-30 event.
**Maruti Suzuki India** — reports the **Eeco crossing 15 lakh cumulative sales**, its latest 5 lakh in about three and a half years, and introduces an Eeco Star Edition with 18 exclusive accessories.

**Coforge** — introduces **AI Launchpad, an open-weight enterprise AI stack** deployable across any cloud, letting clients build, fine-tune and operate a self-owned AI platform with frontier models on demand.

**Anondita Medicare** — declared **L1 bidder by the Central Medical Services Society** for supply of 8,00,62,000 condoms under the Family Planning Programme; **L1 only, with no award and no value stated**.

**Thomas Cook (India)** — with group company SOTC launches **five exclusive charter departures from Bengaluru to Agatti, Lakshadweep from December 2026**, alongside Bhutan charters from Mumbai, as all-inclusive holiday packages.
distress_risk: **NHPC** — an arbitral tribunal **awards BGS-SGS-SOMA Rs 392.31 crore** including interest at 10% from September 2021, on the Subansiri Lower Lot SSL-1 dam and tunnel works, against a claim of Rs 796.87 crore plus EUR 28,76,497.

**Page Industries** — served a **Dubai Court claim of AED 113,548,160.81** plus 9% interest from October 2025 by former UAE distributor Yellow Flower Trading over an allegedly unlawful termination; the company calls the claim without merit.

**Reliance Infrastructure** — named a proposed accused over an alleged **~Rs 179.66 crore under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act**, it receives the Enforcement Directorate's prosecution complaint for pre-cognizance hearing; the financial implication is not ascertainable.

**MosChip Technologies** — the Supreme Court **orders respondents to furnish Rs 200 crore of additional security** in the Ras Al Khaimah dispute that froze its 73% purchase of Vayavya Labs; MosChip is not a party and says the order has no impact on it.

**Spectrum Talent Management** — receives a **GST show-cause notice demanding Rs 10,08,10,284** for IGST of Rs 5.04 crore and an equal penalty from the Additional Commissioner, Noida, under Section 74; it will reply and pursue remedies.

**Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India** — receives a **Karnataka GST show-cause notice demanding Rs 9,78,36,455** for FY2022-23, comprising Rs 6.23 crore of tax, Rs 2.92 crore of interest and Rs 62.84 lakh of penalty.
**Omaxe** — the Securities Appellate Tribunal **dismisses its appeal** against SEBI's order of 30 July 2024, having granted an interim stay in October that year.

**CEAT** — the GST Commissioner (Appeals) **rejects its appeal and allows the Department's cross-appeal**, withdrawing Rs 0.78 crore of earlier relief and taking the FY2020-21 Odisha demand to **Rs 3.84 crore** plus interest and penalty; it may appeal to the GST tribunal.
**TVS Electronics** — discloses a **material pending litigation with the Deputy Commissioner, Uttarakhand**; the annexure carries the particulars and the covering letter states no amount.

**Nuvama Wealth Management** — wholly owned material subsidiary Nuvama Clearing Services receives a **favourable Supreme Court judgment** in a long-standing material litigation; the covering letter quantifies nothing.

**Nila Spaces** — NCLT Ahmedabad notifies it of a petition by Nivedita Ritesh Oswal and another **seeking a Section 244(1) eligibility waiver to pursue oppression and mismanagement proceedings**; the company calls it devoid of merit.

**Parsvnath Developers** — its resolution professional files the **list of creditors as at 31 August**, admitting Rs 5,400.37 crore of 17 secured financial creditors' claims and Rs 1,684.09 crore of 3,362 unsecured financial creditors' claims.

**Karur Vysya Bank** — files its BSE copy of the **Income Tax Appellate Tribunal order** first disclosed to NSE late on 1 September and already carried in that day's digest; the same event, on the other exchange.
other_notable: **The Great Eastern Shipping Company** — its **Rs 900 crore open-market buyback at up to Rs 1,530 a share opens on or before 4 September**, the company having emailed shareholders on 1 September; the board approved it on 27 August and it runs to 11 December at the latest.

**PVR INOX** — files the board resolution for its **Rs 300 crore tender-offer buyback of up to 20,68,965 shares at Rs 1,450**, 2.11% of paid-up capital, passed 31 August with a 4 September record date; the Board may raise the price and cut the share count so long as the size is unchanged.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** — buys back **58,083 shares at an average Rs 295.32** on 2 September, taking its open-market buyback to **9,41,885 shares** cumulatively.

**Persistent Systems** — its board approves **long-term debt financing of up to USD 1,250 million** by external commercial borrowing, non-convertible debentures or similar, plus an Articles amendment on further issue of shares; both go to the members. Debt, not equity.
**Paisalo Digital** — calls an operations and finance committee meeting for **5 September to approve issuing non-convertible debentures** on private placement; debt, and not yet decided.
**Capri Global Capital** — completes its **maiden US dollar bond, raising US$ 300 million of senior secured notes maturing 2029**; debt, so it is not a fresh equity raise however it is filed.

**Knowledge Realty Trust** — confirms that the **sponsor-group offer for sale noticed on 28 August has met the minimum public unitholding requirement**; a trust, and a sale by holders rather than a raise.

**Axis Solutions** — launches an **indigenous hydrogen-to-electricity generator** pairing its proprietary solid-state hydrogen storage with fuel-cell generation; the news feed states no order, capacity or value.

**Sterlite Technologies** — a credit-rating change: CRISIL **upgrades its long-term rating to AA/Stable from AA-/Stable** across Rs 3,564 crore of bank facilities (cut from Rs 4,045 crore) and Rs 390 crore of NCDs, with A1+ reaffirmed on commercial paper.

**V2 Retail** — a credit-rating change: India Ratings **upgrades it to IND A/Positive and IND A1 from IND A-/Stable and IND A2+** on Rs 125 crore of working-capital limits plus Rs 50 crore newly assigned, citing over 60% scale growth and 325 stores.

**GMR Airports** — a credit-rating change: CRISIL **upgrades Rs 5,900 crore of issued non-convertible bonds to AA-/Stable from A+/Stable**, and both CRISIL and CARE assign AA-/Stable to a proposed **Rs 1,500 crore** bond issue refinancing existing bonds.

**Control Print** — a credit-rating change in both directions: CRISIL **migrates it out of Issuer Not Cooperating to A/Stable and A1 from BB/Stable and A4+, then WITHDRAWS the ratings** at the company's request on Rs 80 crore of bank facilities.

**Trident Texofab** — a credit-rating change: CRISIL **reaffirms B/Stable and then WITHDRAWS** its rating on Rs 20 crore of Axis Bank facilities, at the company's own request, because the sanctioned limits fall below the bank's threshold for requiring an external rating.

**Swaraj Suiting** — a credit-rating change: Acuite **assigns a first-time A-/Stable** on Rs 123.09 crore of bank facilities, noting a Rs 421.36 crore spinning project on which Rs 73.59 crore is spent and financial closure is still pending.
**Jeena Sikho Lifecare** — intimates the **launch of six Ayurvedic products** in its Narie Xpert and Porush Xpert ranges, in granule, syrup and tablet form; no revenue expectation is stated.
**TAAL Tech Ltd** — Record date for the Sub-division of the Equity Shares of the Company has been fixed on Tuesday, September 22, 2026.
